sloka: ते वयं रावणं श्रुत्वा हतं सबलवाहनम् ।त्रातारं विद्महे तात नान्यं भुवि नराधिपम् ।तत्परित्रातुमिच्छामो लवणाद्भयपीडितान् ।। ७.६१.२४ ॥
transliteration: te vayaṁ rāvaṇaṁ śrutvā hataṁ sabalavāhanam ।trātāraṁ vidmahe tāta nānyaṁ bhuvi narādhipam ।tatparitrātumicchāmo lavaṇādbhayapīḍitān ।। 7.61.24 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that Ravana, along with his army and vehicles, has been killed, we know no other king on earth as a protector, and therefore, O dear one, we wish for you to protect those afflicted by fear from Lavana.
